classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.sig: 3 tablets (300 mg/120 mg total) by mouth once daily with food for 8 weeks (treatment-naive, with or without compensated cirrhosis; label).
preferredAgent.sigShort: 3 tabs QD with food x8 wk
preferredAgent.plainSig: Take 3 pills together once a day with food for 8 weeks.

records.verificationNote: Read CF p.180 (all DAAs marked '#', carve-out to FFS) and Single PDL p.16 (Drug Class: Hepatitis C - Direct-Acting Antivirals: Mavyret preferred; the rest non-preferred). The PDL page does not print a PA reason per non-preferred drug, so non-preferred items are listed as alternatives and not as paRequired. Mavyret is the only PDL-preferred DAA; sig is standard label dosing for treatment-naive, uncomplicated disease without cirrhosis (duration varies by label and genotype). Cash-price and PA status should be confirmed with the FFS program. [Sonnet check 2026-11-02: All DAAs carved out to FFS (CF '#', p.180), so the Single PDL governs: Mavyret preferred, others listed non-preferred (PDL p.16). PA not printed in either document; partial stands.]
